total_note: Priced so far, before the boat
intro: All four hotels are booked. Here is everything in between for the four of you, arranged through Original Senses, my partner in Athens. A deposit locks it in; the balance is due a month before you land.

transfers.title: Six transfers on Paros, Santorini and Athens
transfers.note: Paros port to Parilio, Parilio to Paros port, Santorini port to Andronis Arcadia, Andronis Arcadia to Santorini airport, Athens airport to One&Only Aesthesis, and Aesthesis to Athens airport. Luxury vehicle with an English-speaking driver. Your Mykonos airport and port transfers come free with Cali.

boats.title: Mykonos to Paros by private boat, with a swim stop
boats.note: A half day instead of a full one: a sturdy motor boat in the Pardo 43 class with captain, one swim stop on the way and your luggage on board. Original Senses is pricing the steadiest option around €3,000 to €4,000, with a morning departure when the sea is usually calmest.

ferries.title: Paros to Santorini on the Blue Star Delos
ferries.note: Moved off the high-speed catamaran onto the Blue Star Delos, one of the big conventional ferries that carry cars, so the crossing is much steadier. Departs Paros 11:45am, arrives Santorini 2:50pm, business seats for four. A driver meets you at the port for Andronis Arcadia.

fine_boat: The boat: 30% of the charter confirms it. Cancelling 45 to 30 days before the day costs 50% of the charter, and inside 30 days 100%. If the captain or port authority cancels for weather or a technical problem, it is refunded. Fuel can move with the market; you hear about any change in advance.
how: The deposit is set by Original Senses under their terms: 30% of the boat, 25% of the transfers and the ferry fare in full. The balance is due 30 days before you arrive.
pending_note: The Mykonos to Paros boat is being re-priced as a half day, and the Santorini to Athens flight is off since you are booking it yourselves. I will send the updated payment link as soon as Original Senses comes back.
